zh.title: 美國擬對巴西進口成品航空器加徵 10% 關稅，徵詢公眾意見
zh.summary: 美國貿易代表署提議取消巴西成品航空器現有的第 301 條關稅豁免，擬加徵 10% 從價稅。書面意見收至 12 月 30 日。
body: 美國貿易代表署（USTR）11 月 25 日公布第 301 條措施修訂提案，擬取消巴西成品航空器的現有豁免，對自巴西進口的這類產品加徵 10% 從價關稅。USTR 將就提案徵詢意見。
書面意見截止日為 2026 年 12 月 30 日。USTR 預計於 2027 年 1 月 14 日舉行聽證，有意出席陳述者須在 12 月 7 日前提出申請和證詞摘要。
巴西航空工業公司（Embraer）向巴西媒體 UOL 表示，正在評估美方文件，並將主張維持航空產業的零關稅待遇。

en.title: U.S. proposes a 10% tariff on finished aircraft imported from Brazil
en.summary: The U.S. Trade Representative proposes ending the current Section 301 exemption for finished aircraft from Brazil and applying a 10% duty. Written comments are due December 30.
body: The Office of the U.S. Trade Representative announced its proposed changes on November 25. The aircraft measure would remove the existing exemption for finished aircraft from Brazil and apply a 10% tariff based on the import value. The agency is seeking public comment on the proposal.
Written submissions are due December 30, 2026. USTR plans to hold a hearing on January 14, 2027. Requests to testify, with a summary of proposed testimony, are due December 7.
Brazilian aircraft manufacturer Embraer told UOL that it was reviewing the U.S. document and would advocate keeping aerospace trade tariff-free.

facts.claim: USTR proposed ending the exemption and imposing a 10% ad valorem duty on finished aircraft imported from Brazil.
Written comments close December 30, a hearing is planned January 14, and requests to testify are due December 7.
Embraer told UOL it was reviewing the proposal and would advocate keeping aerospace trade tariff-free.
